local p = {}

local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs

local areaData = mw.loadData("Module:Minimap/Data")

-- list of commonly used marker icons
local markerData = {
	["exclamation mark"] = {
		file = "[[File:Exclamation mark map icon.png|25px|link=]]"
	}
}

local function starts_with(str, start)
   return string.sub(str,1,string.len(start)) == start
end

local function split_string(inputstr, sep)
	local ret = {}
	for str in string.gmatch(inputstr, "([^"..sep.."]+)") do
		table.insert(ret, str)
	end
	return ret
end

function p._main(area, x, y, width, height, markers)
	if not x or not y then
		error("Missing coordinates")
	end

	area = areaData[area]
	if not area then
		error("Unknown area")
	end
	
	x = tonumber(x)
	y = tonumber(y)
	width = width or 240
	height = height or 240

	local xOffset = (x - width * 0.5) * (-1)
	local yOffset = (y - height * 0.5) * (-1)
	
	local minimap = mw.html.create("div")
		:addClass("area-minimap")
		:addClass(area.imageClass)
		:css{
			width = width .. "px",
			height = height .. "px",
			["background-position"] = xOffset .. "px " .. yOffset .. "px"
		}

	if markers then
		for i, marker in ipairs(markers) do
			local text = split_string(marker, ';')
			local icon = text[1]
			local xmarker = text[2]
			local ymarker = text[3]
			
			-- check for alias first, otherwise default to exclamation mark 
			marker = markerData[icon] or markerData["exclamation mark"]
			
			-- if a mediawiki file is given, use that image instead
			if starts_with(tostring(icon), "[[File:") then
				marker.file = split_string(icon, ']')[1] .. "|25px|link=]]"
			end
			
			local markerTag = minimap:tag("span"):addClass("minimap-marker"):wikitext(marker.file)
			
			-- adjust marker position with given coords, defaults to center when missing
			if xmarker and ymarker then
				local dx = xmarker - x + width * 0.5
				local dy = ymarker - y + height * 0.5
				
				markerTag:css{
					left = dx .. "px",
					top = dy .. "px"
				}
			end
		end
	end

	return tostring(minimap)
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args = getArgs(frame)
    local area = args.area and mw.ustring.lower(args.area)
	local x = args.x
	local y = args.y
    local width = args["width"] or args["size"]
    local height = args["height"] or args["size"]
    
    local markers = {}
	if args["marker"] then
		table.insert(markers, args["marker"])
	end
	local i = 2
	while args["marker" .. i] do
		table.insert(markers, args["marker" .. i])
		i = i + 1
	end

    return p._main(area, x, y, width, height, markers)
end

return p
